info.name: Returns a quote for an imperative swap

params.name: amount
params.description: Input amount as a scaled integer. For example, 1 SOL is 1000000000.

params.name: slippageBps
params.description:
Max allowed slippage for the swap. Allowed values are:
- a u16 which specifies the maximum allowed slippage in basis points
- the string value "auto", where the server determines the maximum allowed slippage
  automatically

params.name: priceImpactTolerancePct
params.description:
If specified, the API will return an error if the price impact of the route is greater than
the specified percentage. If unspecified, the server will determine the threshold. For
example, 10 is 10% and 100 is 100%.

params.name: dexes
params.description: Comma-separated list of DEXes to include. If not specified, all DEXes will be included.

params.name: excludeDexes
params.description: Comma-separated list of DEXes to exclude. If not specified, all DEXes will be included.

params.name: platformFeeBps
params.description:
Optional platform fee in basis points. This should only be nonzero if the swap will collect
the platform fee. The swap must specify a valid fee account and that fee account must be
able to collect the fee mint at execution time.

params.name: platformFeeMode
params.description: Optional platform fee mode. If not specified, the default is `outputMint`.

params.name: sponsoredSwap
params.description:
This should be specified as true if and only if the quote will be used for a sponsored swap.
If true, then the quote will account for any additional token 2022 transfer fees that apply
to the input and output mints for a sponsored swap.

params.name: sponsorExec
params.description:
The execution mode that will be used for the sponsored swap. This parameter is only relevant
when `sponsoredSwap` is true. True indicates that the sponsor will be the executor of the
swap. False indicates that the user will be the executor of the swap. Default is true.

params.name: destinationSwap
params.description:
This should be specified as true if and only if the quote will be used for a destination
token account swap. If true, then the quote will account for any additional token 2022
transfer fees that apply to the output mint for a destination token account swap.

params.name: onlyDirectRoutes
params.description: If true, only use single-leg routes

params.name: maxRouteLength
params.description:
If specified, the route will be limited to the specified number of legs. Ignored if
`only_direct_routes` is true.

params.name: onlyJitRoutes
params.description: If true, only use JIT routes. Every leg in the route will use the JIT router.

params.name: forJitoBundle
params.description:
If true, only use routes that are compatible with Jito bundles. This should only be
specified as true if the swap will be executed in a Jito bundle. Default is false.

params.name: skipPumpfunCashbackClaim
params.description:
If true, Pump.fun cashback will not be claimed for cashback-eligible coins. When set, sell
quotes include the full creator fee, and execution skips Pump.fun cashback claiming. Default
is false. Cannot be used with sponsor-executed swaps (`sponsorExec` is true or defaulted to
true).
